summary: Implemented the endpoint-ruleset builtins helper. Changes: (1) botocore/regions.py: added `from enum import Enum` and appended the str-valued EndpointResolverBuiltins enum with all eleven members, values and per-member comments. (2) botocore/args.py: imported the enum as EPRBuiltins; made the STS global-endpoint predicate accept an absent endpoint configuration (treated as no variant tags); added ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults after _ensure_boolean, which composes the bridge's FIPS and DualStack lookups and the existing S3 and STS predicates. SDK::Endpoint is returned as None when absent, so all eleven keys are always present. (3) tests/unit/test_args.py: added TestEndpointResolverBuiltins (derives from unittest.TestCase) with one test per behavioral criterion, including a single custom-data legacy-URL test and a single bundled-data absent test. Verification: test_args.py, test_client.py and test_regions.py pass (415 tests) using the prepared venv. Line lengths are within 79 columns in all added lines; the only over-length line (args.py:315) is pre-existing. black and isort are not installed in the venv, so formatting was checked by hand only. Nothing was committed. Judgment calls: None for absent SDK::Endpoint value; the helper calls the bridge's private lookup methods as the spec requires.
